name: Passkey Authentication to Home
summary: The user completes a valid passkey assertion, the server resolves the existing durable user, and the client opens the application home view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and a registered passkey is available

serverInteraction.intent: Issue and validate a passkey authentication challenge, resolve the existing durable user, advance the signature counter, and establish the application session.

sourceReferences.note: Anonymous passwordless begin and complete endpoints delegate directly to IAppUserPasskeyManager.

Passwordless authentication consumes and validates the challenge, resolves the stored credential to one durable user, validates the WebAuthn assertion, advances the signature counter, emits the canonical runtime audit events, and resolves the landing destination. The current manager does not itself establish an application session.
The current React Native Use Passkey action is presentation-only and does not yet execute the generated challenge endpoints or a native passkey assertion ceremony.
Implementation reconciliation reopened this scenario until browser session establishment and native mobile passkey/token-session completion are source-supported.
